title: SanDisk Cerebrum — AI Die Yield Intelligence
description: Multimodal AI system to classify semiconductor wafer dies as pass or fail using 1D CNN signal analysis and selective cascade architecture.
longDescription: Developed a multimodal AI system to classify semiconductor wafer dies as pass or fail. Combined electrical and spatial features with a 1D CNN-based signal analysis stream in a selective cascade architecture to detect defects, improve precision, and reduce unnecessary secondary analysis. Ranked Top 10 All India in the SanDisk Cerebrum Hackathon.

title: Journey360 — Intelligent Travel Companion
description: AI-powered travel companion integrating smart itinerary planning, safety alerts, adaptive journey analyzer, and multilingual assistance.
longDescription: Built an AI-powered travel companion integrating itinerary planning, navigation, weather, safety alerts, local news, budgeting, and multilingual assistance. Developed a Journey Impact Analyzer to evaluate how changes in time, routes, budget, or weather affect travel plans and recommend adaptive actions using ActionVector DB. Secured 3rd Place & $150 at Panimalar Engineering College.

title: CyberShield — AI-Powered Phishing Detection
description: AI-powered cybersecurity solution to identify suspicious offers and phishing attempts, strengthening digital safety.
longDescription: Developed an AI-powered cybersecurity solution to identify suspicious offers and phishing attempts. Designed the platform to help users recognize potential online threats and improve digital safety. Built with FastAPI backend and sophisticated ML/NLP models for high accuracy threat detection. Secured Runner-Up at the Cyberverse Hackathon at VIT Vellore.

title: AI-Based Lane Detection & Traffic Monitoring
description: Real-time traffic analysis combining lane detection, vehicle monitoring, traffic-density classification, and congestion analysis.
longDescription: Developed a real-time traffic analysis system combining lane detection, vehicle monitoring, traffic-density classification, and congestion analysis. Designed features for lane-change alerts, type-wise vehicle counting, speed estimation, and GPS/satellite traffic-condition visualization with real-time analytics panels.

title: GramOne — Rural Governance & Impact Platform
description: Rural problem-to-impact platform connecting citizens, Panchayat administrators, field workers, IoT monitoring, and CSR sponsors.
longDescription: Built a rural problem-to-impact platform connecting citizens, Panchayat administrators, field workers, and CSR sponsors. Integrated AI-assisted issue reporting, evidence-based resolution tracking, IoT sensor monitoring, automated alerts, and CSR project matching to empower rural communities. Secured Special Mention & 5th Prize at SRCAS, Coimbatore.

title: RAG Uzhavan — AI-Powered Precision Farming
description: Region-aware agricultural intelligence platform combining RAG, agricultural telemetry, sensor alerts, and Tamil-English voice support.
longDescription: Developed a region-aware agricultural intelligence platform that combines retrieval-augmented generation, agricultural data sources, and IoT field telemetry. Features include source-grounded farmer assistance, interactive agricultural maps, crop-related insights, sensor alerts, and Tamil-English voice support.

title: Ransomware Simulator & Defence Mechanism
description: Educational simulator demonstrating ransomware-style file encryption, detection, and recovery workflows.
longDescription: Developed a ransomware simulation tool that detects corrupted files and demonstrates file encryption and decryption workflows for security testing and analysis. Implemented automated corrupted-file detection with configurable auto-deletion of infected files to simulate basic incident response and recovery behavior. Built for academic learning, it allows users to upload files, simulate encryption, view a generated key, and securely restore data.

title: Smart Pantry Management System
description: IoT-based kitchen inventory tracking with RFID, ultrasonic sensors, and dish recommendation engine.
longDescription: Developed an IoT-based Smart Pantry system using RFID, ultrasonic, and vibration sensors for real-time food inventory tracking and accurate detection of item placement or removal. Built an OLED-based live inventory display and inventory-driven dish recommendation feature on a web dashboard using available ingredients.

title: Blood Donation Website
description: Web platform connecting blood donors and recipients with real-time matching based on blood group and location.
longDescription: Developed a web platform to connect blood donors and recipients, enabling quick search and real-time matching based on blood group, location, and availability. Implemented secure user authentication with registration and login features to manage donor and recipient profiles.
